<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="PATCH" path="/v1/api_keys/{id}"}
#docs
Send `permissions` to replace the key's map (its `scope` follows the map), or `permissions: null` to return the key to its scope. The change applies to the next request made with the key. The caller can grant only what they hold.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The api key's id. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | The api key's name. |
| `permissions` | `object` | no | Access per resource, for example `{"invoices": "read", "customers": "write"}`. `read` allows the resource's read operations; `write` allows all of them. A resource not named is refused. Null or omitted: the key works by its scope. |
| `scope` | `string` | no | With no permission map: the key's scope. Must agree with a map when both are sent. One of `read`, `write`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The api key's id (key_…). |
| `name` | `string` | The key's name. |
| `prefix` | `string` | The first characters of the key, so you can recognize it. The full key is shown only once, when you create it. |
| `livemode` | `string` | `live` for a live key, `test` for a test key. One of `test`, `live`, `all`. |
| `scope` | `string` | What the key can do: `read` or `write`. One of `read`, `write`. |
| `secret` | `string` | Returned once at creation only. |
| `last_used_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the key was last used (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the api key was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `revoked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the key was revoked (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the key stops working (ISO-8601 UTC), or null if it never expires. |
| `permissions` | `object` | The key's permission map. Null: the key works by its scope. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Invalid body |
| `403` | The caller cannot grant this access (`code: permission_escalation`) |
| `404` | No such API key |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PATCH "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/api_keys/key_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Example"
  }'
```
